The independent check must therefore compare the discrete Neumann-operator spectrum itself against analytic rigid-box modes — detection-resolution artifacts are not operator error.
preregistration: Commit and push this fixed plan before any eigencomputation. The runner verifies plan bytes; tolerances and verdict vocabulary below are frozen.
operator: seven-point second-difference Neumann Laplacian, cell-centered pressure, ghost-node Neumann convention identical to the canonical PFFDTD stencil
eigensolver: scipy.sparse.linalg.eigsh(k lowest, sigma=-1, which='LM', tol<=1e-9); full basis for h=0.1

comparisons.name: discrete_operator_exactness
comparisons.reference: closed-form discrete Neumann eigenvalues lambda = (2/h)^2 * sum_i sin^2(pi*n_i/(2*N_i))

comparisons.name: continuum_mode_agreement
comparisons.metric: relative frequency error per analytic mode vs nearest discrete mode; every analytic mode below the cutoff must be matched

comparisons.name: dispersion_bound
comparisons.reference: seven-point leading dispersion: relative error <= (pi*f*h/c)^2/12 times declared safety factor 2.0

comparisons.name: unresolved_cluster_coverage
comparisons.reference: the 12 analytic clusters unresolved under record-peak detection in evidence r130d_reproduction_isolation_diagnostic_evidence.json; every unresolved analytic mode must be present in the discrete spectrum

honesty: This validates the discrete spatial operator's spectrum against physics, not the canonical impulse observable; the original contract remains SELF_CONVERGENCE_FAILED and product NO_GO. If any comparison fails, the verdict is PHYSICS_NOT_VALIDATED with the failing modes recorded verbatim.
